title: Introduction
text: Hi, I'm Aishwarya from the Mycroft team. This video covers the real start of the second agent, the one that traces a patent citation lineage, not just its claims. 12 real citations on one patent.

title: The Real Bug
text: Clean, 12 citations parsed, one patent, 11 papers. But the field that was supposed to say this is non-patent literature wasn't checking for empty text. It was checking for missing text. On this table, missing text isn't missing, it's an empty string. Every single citation was passing that check, whether it had a real patent number or not. Fixed the check, reran it. Same 12,

text: Same one, same 11.
